title: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
page_numbering: PDF pages, 1-based unless locator explicitly refers to printed page

claims.claim: State consists of body pose, velocity and IMU biases; visual-inertial optimization combines preintegrated inertial and robust reprojection terms
Three-stage initialization uses visual MAP, inertial-only MAP, then joint VI MAP; positive scale via multiplicative exp update
Weak motion excitation can delay accurate initialization; scale/gravity refinement is included
New place recognition checks geometric consistency and existing covisible keyframes before waiting for future frames
Map merging fuses duplicate points and performs welding BA plus essential-graph propagation
EuRoC stereo-inertial mean RMS ATE is 0.035 m and monocular-inertial 0.043 m
claims.conditions: Median of 10 executions per sequence; average across 11 sequences; SE(3) alignment; original table comparators have footnoted protocol differences

claims.claim: TUM-VI room mean ATE 0.009 m stereo-inertial and 0.011 m monocular-inertial
claims.conditions: 6 room sequences; medians of 3 executions; full ground truth available for room; not full-trajectory GT for most other TUM-VI sequences

claims.claim: EuRoC V202 stereo-inertial tracking takes 33.05±9.29 ms
claims.conditions: i7-7700 3.6GHz CPU, 32GB; separate mapping/loop/global BA threads

claims.claim: Low texture and sparse nearby features are failure modes; outdoor sequences remove points farther than 20 m
Learned features/depth or downstream policy can be interfaced with this estimator, but require renewed uncertainty and failure testing
claims.locator: Reader synthesis based on module interfaces; not a reported experiment

scope_notes: This is a MAP optimization-based SLAM library, not an ESKF implementation.
No new RGB-D benchmark reproduced in this note.
Source PDF and original figures are not redistributed.
